name: @adatechnology/desktop-app
description: The test rooms as a desktop app (Electron, the same Chromium as the site and the Playwright tests): the 4280's pages served cross-origin isolated from inside the app, so SharedArrayBuffer and Jolt's multithreaded build are on. A start menu of every room and area, --area=<id> to open one, AppImage on Linux.
author: Ada Technology

scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && node node_modules/electron/install.js && electron .
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.18.1 --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.json
scripts.check: pnpm run build && node node_modules/electron/install.js && node dist/check-desktop.js
